Name: Deadly Field
Description: Choose one 5-foot space on a surface you can see within the spell’s range. Grasping undead hands and claws burst forth from the ground in a 15-foot cube centered on that space, which remain for the spell’s duration. If a creature enters one of these spaces for the first time on their turn or starts their turn within them (including those raised above the ground), they must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are pulled to the ground, fall prone, and are restrained until the start of their next turn, taking 2d8 bludgeoning damage. If they succeed, they can move through these spaces as difficult terrain. A creature that moves into one of these spaces willingly takes bludgeoning damage per space equal to the level this spell was cast at.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 3rd level or higher, you can choose one of the following effects for each level above 2nd:
● The size of the cube grows by 10 feet on each side, but the cube remains 15 feet tall.
● The damage caused by failing the Strength save increases by 1d8.
